citations.claim: total energy at initial state defines baseline
total energy still near baseline one step before failure
first violating step: energy jumps beyond allowed limit
light body leaves with unphysically large downward speed after floor plus body interaction

counterfactual.change: Set bodies[1].e from 1 to 0 (single field); elastic bounce removed, energy stays bounded.

explanation: Two vertically aligned elastic (e=1) bodies fall under gravity 20. Light lower body bounces off floor then collides with heavy falling upper body within the same step/substeps. Sequential impulse plus positional correction with full restitution amplifies the light-body velocity (40.2 speed at step 26) injecting ~46J in one step (225.3->271.6 vs E0 224), exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Making one collision inelastic removes the super-elastic amplification and the violation disappears.
vision_note: Two small blue bodies fall straight down in vertical alignment, closing the gap from steps 23 to 25 until they touch. At step 26 both are suddenly much lower with the lower body at the floor, indicating a floor bounce combined with a body-body collision.
